bagPolicy.summary: Large backpacks, suitcases, beach bags and equipment bags cannot be brought in. The FAQ gives no numeric limit for smaller bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Street parking is available near the theatre; check local parking signs.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theatre FAQ does not designate a rideshare location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Venue concessions are cashless; outside food and drinks are not permitted.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: A separate accessible seating ticket is not required. Ask security at arrival for a chair in the ADA section and plan to arrive near door time.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The published FAQ and policies do not give a re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Most tickets use AXS Mobile. The Bluebird box office opens 30 minutes before doors on show days, and in-person tickets carry a $2.50 fee.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The venue uses walk-through metal detectors and asks guests to allow time for screening. A Quick Pass uses a dedicated general-admission line at normal door time and requires an event ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
